brandKit.posterDescription: Yellow morning board, cream card, amber type. One real plate of nasi lemak, the price in a brown pill, no stock-photo clutter.
brandKit.posterStyleSummary: Kopitiam yellow ground, cream paper, and brown lettering, the same colours as the shop sign. One dish, one price.
brandKit.websiteVoiceSummary: Like the uncle at the counter: short, warm, Bahasa Melayu and English in the same breath. The dish and the price come first. No hard sell.
brandKit.ethos: Shah Alam kopitiam since 1986. Kaya toast at the counter, nasi lemak before the office rush. Halal, and the regulars still have a usual.
brandKit.targetCustomers: Shah Alam office workers who eat before 9am, and families who come in on Saturday for the same usual.
